70 employees × Rp 1,075 million of value added per worker — the Fintech anchor

Output is gross value added — what the company adds to GDP: the part of what it earns that it creates itself, after taking out everything it buys in from other firms. Revenue is a bigger number, and the wage bill is one component of this one. Nobody publishes value added, so the census estimates it from headcount and a BPS sector anchor; funding, valuation and GMV never enter.
